DashboardState.title: DashboardState
DashboardState.description: Consolidated state of the executive financial & personal assistant dashboard

userId.description: The UID or identifier of the user/session updating this state

payload.description: Serialized JSON string representing dashboard records, settings, and tables (or chunk payload)

isChunked.description: Whether this state payload is split across multiple chunk documents

totalChunks.description: Total number of chunk documents for this state payload

chunkIndex.description: The index of this chunk if multi-part payload

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last update

updatedBy.description: Email or display name of the user who made the last change

VaultFile.title: VaultFile
VaultFile.description: Encrypted or binary document / photo file payload stored separately from master state

docId.description: The unique document identifier matching db.documents

fileData.description: Base64 dataURI or chunk of the document/media file

userId.description: User UID who owns this file

/app_data/{docId}.description: Shared executive dashboard data and chunks for multi-device sync

/vault_files/{docId}.description: Document vault binaries, PDF files, and image attachments
